sentences.text:
Court No. - 69 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 1084 of 2023 Applicant :- Sonu@ Mahesh And 2 Others Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Dubey,Mohit Gautam Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants and Ms. Arti Agarwal, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Sonu @ Mahesh,
Bhagat Singh and Smt. Kamlesh with the prayer to allow the present application and quash the cognizance order dated 18.02.2021 passed by 7th Additional Civil Judge (J.D.) / A.C.J.M., Meerut and charge-sheet dated 22.08.2020 as well as entire criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No. 620 of 2021 (State Vs. Sonu & Ors) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Transport Nagar, District Meerut, arising out of the Case Crime No.
617 of 2018 with a further prayer that proceedings of the aforesaid case be stayed against the Sonu@ Mahesh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133851770/

sentences.text: 1 applicants during the pendency of the present application.
The present dispute between the parties relates to matrimonial dispute.
Learned counsel for the applicants states that the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court for an effort to settle the dispute amicably between the parties.

In view of the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants, let the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court, subject to the applicants depositing a sum of Rs.35,000/- within two weeks from today before the Mediation Centre, out of which Rs.30,000/-
shall be paid to the opposite party no. 2 after conclusion of the process of mediation.
In case the amount is deposited, the Mediation Centre will issue notices to both the parties returnable within a period of three weeks.
Learned mediator shall make an endeavour to conclude the same within three months.
Let the matter be listed on 02nd May, 2023.
On that date learned counsels for the parties shall inform the Court regarding outcome of the proceedings of mediation.
The Mediation Centre shall also send its report to this Court by the next date.
Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of aforesaid case against the applicants shall remain stayed.

Order Date :- 17.1.2023 AS Rathore (Samit Gopal,J.)
